# dsh-archived-sessions
**Browse archived conversations and restore them to the sidebar from Settings.**
A small DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an **Archived Sessions** page under Settings. It lists eve
ry archived conversation with its workspace and last-updated time, supports searching, and restores
a conversation to its original workspace in one click.
## Features

- Lists archived conversations with title, workspace, and last update
- Search by conversation title

or workspace
- One-click **Restore** puts the conversation back in its original workspace
- Live up

dates from the workspace archive stream
- Follows the host theme and UI language (English / 中文)
- No
message content is read; the page only uses session metadata
> Archived conversations cannot be opened directly in Harness. Restore one first, then open it from
onversations cannot be opened directly in Harness. Restore one first, then open it from the sidebar.

- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (the `settings.section` slot and workspace archive

stream)
